_scope: The denominator is the code that can run without a host process or a GPU.
HeliosView.mm      AppKit configure sheet; needs legacyScreenSaver to host it
HeliosRenderer.mm  Metal pipeline setup; needs a device and a drawable
Shaders.metal      not instrumentable by llvm-cov at all
Counting those would cap coverage near 40% and make any threshold arbitrary.
Sphere-map and matrix math mirrored out of the shaders into testable C++
belongs in sources and should be covered.
